draft_evidence.quote: He caught himself, past the middle of it, running the room as an instrument — six places, one board, two doors, a fire — and put the instrument down. Not the new one; he had no hand on that yet. The old one; the count. For the better part of an hour he did nothing with any of it, which was the second time this year and the first time on ground no registry had drawn.

comparison_evidence.quote: He caught himself, somewhere past the middle of it, running the room as an instrument — six places, one board, two doors, a fire, the light in the window gone from yellow to nothing — and put the instrument down. Not the new one. He did not have a hand on that yet. The old one; the count. He sat in a common room in a walled steading two days east of Lowmarch, with five people who knew both his ledgers, on a birthday nobody with a seal knew the date of, and for the better part of an hour did nothing with any of it, which was the second time this year and the first time on ground no registry had drawn.
